GET THE KEYS

Before you apply.

Talk to the Elm Auto team ↗(403) 328-3039
What if my credit isn’t perfect?+

You don’t need perfect credit to start the conversation. Elm Auto works with good, bad and limited credit histories. Financing is subject to lender approval.

Do I need to choose a vehicle first?+

No. Apply first, then tell us what you need and what you want to spend. We’ll help find vehicles that fit your needs and financing options.

Is delivery really free?+

Yes. Elm Auto delivers vehicles free across Alberta, including cities, small towns and rural addresses. The team arranges delivery after the vehicle and financing details are finalized.
